subject: ophthalmology
title: Retinal detachment and retinal degenerations

steps.tx: **Rhegmatogenous detachment** follows a full thickness break (flashes, new floaters, Shafer tobacco dust, spreading curtain or shadow) with liquefied vitreous dissecting neurosensory retina from pigment epithelium; lattice degeneration, myopia, trauma and post cataract eyes predispose. **Macula on** (central vision preserved) operates emergently; macula off repairs within days. Barrage laser seals flat tears and lattice; **scleral buckling** indents wall to breaks, **vitrectomy** clears traction with gas or oil tamponade, pneumatic retinopexy suits superior single breaks. Fellow eye prophylaxis follows.
steps.say: Curtain shadow after flashes is detachment: macula on means tonight. Laser seals flat tears; buckle or vitrectomy reattaches.

steps.tx: **Tractional detachment** (proliferative diabetic fibrovascular membranes, sickle sea fans, ROP ridge) pulls retina tented with concave configuration, needing vitrectomy with membrane peeling before macular threat; **exudative detachment** (Harada, posterior scleritis, tumours, severe hypertension) accumulates shifting subretinal fluid without breaks, settling with systemic disease control. B scan separates break related from tractional or exudative patterns when no view. Combined tractional rhegmatogenous disease (diabetic with breaks) needs vitrectomy with tamponade.
steps.say: Tented pulled retina is tractional: peel membranes. Shifting fluid without breaks is exudative: treat the system.

steps.tx: **Retinitis pigmentosa** (rod cone dystrophy, often autosomal recessive or Usher with deafness) night blinds early with bone spicule pigmentation, arteriolar attenuation and waxy disc pallor, constricting fields to tunnel with extinguished ERG; vitamin A palmitate debates slow decline while gene therapy (RPE65) rescues selected children and low vision aids sustain. **Lattice degeneration** (lattice lines with atrophic holes in myopes) lasers prophylactically. Retinoschisis splits layers (X linked boys with spoke wheel macula) observing unless detaching.
steps.say: Night blind youth with bone spicules: retinitis pigmentosa. Lattice with holes in myope: laser before it tears.

steps.tx: **Retinopathy of prematurity** arrests retinal vascularisation in low birthweight infants on oxygen: staged ridge with plus disease (dilated tortuous posterior vessels) toward tractional detachment and blindness. Screening (under 32 weeks or 1500 g patterns) with timely peripheral laser ablation (or anti VEGF selected) aborts progression; stage 4 and 5 need vitrectomy or buckle. Aggressive posterior ROP skips stages rapidly. Oxygen titration with neonatal collaboration prevents while saving lives.
steps.say: Preemie ridge with plus vessels needs laser now. Screen tiny babies before traction blinds.
